discover_repo_root (sc-jev-check/src/run/mod.rs:748-805): The fallback to cwd is now narrow. classify_discovery returns cwd only when git ran and found no work tree and enclosing_git_entry finds no .git at or above start, or when git is not installed (IoFailed NotFound). If git finds no work tree but an ancestor holds .git, it returns INPUT_INVALID, so a subdirectory is never silently taken as the root. Every other discover_toplevel error is propagated as Err. This closes the QA-1 observation that any error was mapped silently to cwd. enclosing_git_entry honours GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES, walks upward and always terminates, using symlink_metadata with no reads and no unbounded work. There is no traversal exposure.

Bounded tmp retry (sc-jev-check/src/session/mod.rs:482-500): open_unique_tmp makes at most TMP_OPEN_ATTEMPTS = 8 tries, each with a fresh 64-bit random name and create_new. Only AlreadyExists is retried. Any other error returns at once, and the final error is surfaced. There is no tight unbounded loop. The write_private cleanup is correct: on any write or rename failure the tmp file is removed, and the mode is 0600. The directory sync is best effort and is not a save failure, which is a documented and acceptable tradeoff. Retry applies only to a local name collision and is not a side-effecting retry.

Ask path (sc-jev-check/src/run/mod.rs:689-730 and sc-jev-py/src/run.rs:268-287): ask reads the session read-only and never rewrites it. It validates the follow-up, rebuilds the registry for the stored backend only, via config.registry or BackendRegistry::from_env (keys via sc_agent_secrets), and runs validate_for_send before send. The cancel token is propagated. In the Python host, ask_with releases the GIL through py.detach and flushes the logger. No key is cached in LiveSession. The request is bounded by the backend byte cap, and the 8 MiB session read cap is unchanged.

Pipe-error mapping: sc-ai/src/main.rs:27-28 and sc-treesitter/src/main.rs:27-28 map a stdout write_all failure to JevError::io_failed('stdout', &error) and exit with code 2. The error type keeps only the ErrorKind, and the doc test at sc-agent-types/src/error.rs:476-483 asserts the raw cause text ('secret') is not leaked. So the mapping adds no leak and no hang. I found no BrokenPipe special-casing that could mask a real failure.

Observations carried from QA-1, none raised as findings: expired session files are never deleted, kill_and_reap kills only the direct child, git helpers have no wall-clock deadline, timeout_seconds has no upper bound, --request-json has no size cap, and sc-agent-secrets dotenv.rs reads .env with no size cap. They are all outside the fix-round regression scope. Per the owner rule I request no new gates, receipts or docs-consistency checks.
